study_note: Fresh Dog Stand training on seeds 55, 56 and 57. Preserve the sampled Dog Walk/Trot/Run learner: 1M decisions, H3/J8/K1, N128/C16/A4/B256, fixed joint post-tanh entropy 0.0021, reward-only critics, action-local adaptive Q scaling and critic geometry every 1k updates. Retain every 25k checkpoint. State observations, two raw control steps per decision, 500 decisions per episode.
